name: xeruca-player
description: A portable local video library for Codex with captions, transcription, translation, and an in-page player.

interface.shortDescription: Call in a video. Your agent handles the rest.
interface.longDescription: Download authorized videos, reuse available captions, transcribe locally or with explicit OpenAI API consent, translate subtitles, and watch from a persistent localhost library inside Codex.
capabilities: Local Whisper or OpenAI API transcription
Same-origin iframe player with resume progress
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $watch-video to add an authorized video to INSU Player and open the local library.
